answer: Clone desks answer every ping from one shared inbox. Each applicant rents a haven roost that admits only one live session. Three raven couriers, kin skipped and 4 hours 40 minutes apart, each leave a walnut shell H(roost_id, courier_pk, height, i), opened after a 16-minute live ACK from that courier's backbone. The key locks 25 POA for 5 epochs and pays 0.39 POA per drop. Reviewers rebuild the roost calendar and openings on-ledger. A shared haven, missed drop, or early-opened walnut shell sends 32 percent of the lock to the spotting courier and grounds the key 6 epochs.
